name: Boise National Forest
policyReason: The national Forest Service page says dogs are allowed in national forests, and the forest's own pages give only leash and site rules and name no forest-wide ban.
summary: Dogs are allowed across the forest; keep them leashed in campgrounds and other developed sites.

excerpts.quote: Not sure if you can bring your dog to the national forests on your next adventure? The answer is, “Yes!”
Dogs must be on a leash.

dogRules.text: Pets on leashes of 6 ft or less in designated recreation areas.
Kirkham Hot Springs: no dogs on trails, in or near the hot springs.
